en.titre:
5 HABITS THAT MAKE
A MAN STAND OUT.

en.texte: Start the day with one thing done. It takes 2 minutes and sets the tone for everything after.
Swap the hoodie for a jacket once in a while. People treat you the way you show up.
Most men start too hard and stop. Running coach apps like Atala start at your level and build up slowly.
Keep a bottle on your desk and refill it. Even mild dehydration drains your focus.
Swap the last scroll of the day for 10 pages. Your mind slows down before sleep.
